transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Well, I'm here because... things have just gotten out of hand. After I eat too much, I keep going into the bathroom and making myself throw up. I do it so I won't gain weight, but it's gotten to the point where I'm genuinely scared I can't stop doing it.
In addition to making yourself vomit, have you done anything else like severely restricting your food, using laxatives, or exercising a lot to try to control your weight?

No, I haven't really done any of that. I don't use laxatives or anything, and I definitely don't exercise a lot. I work as a mechanic, so I'm on my feet and moving around all day at the shop, but I don't go to the gym or run or anything to try to burn off what I eat. And I don't really starve myself either. It's just the throwing up.

latest_inference.note: The patient denied other behaviors such as food restriction, laxative use, or excessive exercise, which makes F50.0 (Anorexia Nervosa) and F50.1 (Atypical Anorexia Nervosa) less likely. The focus on purging without other compensatory behaviors points more strongly to F50.2 (Bulimia Nervosa).
